exposure: full-course nursing combined with the Lamaze pain-relieving method
cohort: The study included 124 primipara female athletes undergoing natural delivery, randomized into two groups.
finding: Full-course nursing combined with the Lamaze method significantly shortened labor, reduced pain, enhanced self-efficacy, improved breastfeeding rates, minimized perineal trauma, and reduced postoperative complications in primipara female athletes.
mod_finding: The observation group, receiving the combined nursing and Lamaze method, had a lower cesarean section rate.
followup_time: 3 days postpartum (for lactation volume); Apgar scores at 1, 5, and 10 minutes postpartum; other outcomes like postoperative complications and breastfeeding rates are implied to be assessed shortly after birth without a specific end date mentioned.
